name: Poznan University of Medical Sciences
summary: Poznan medical university founded in 1919, teaching in English since 1993: a six-year MD and a five-year DDS, entered by science quiz and interview.

ib.text: IB holders need HL in Biology, Chemistry or Physics; places go on a 60-question science quiz and an interview. The English-test list does not name the IB, so ask admissions whether yours counts.

programmes.name: Medicine
programmes.about: Six-year, 360-ECTS medical degree straight from school: basic sciences first, patient contact from year two, clinical rotations from year four in PUMS's own hospitals, with NBME exams and a Kaplan review course built in.
programmes.ib: HL in Biology, Chemistry or Physics is required; admission is by a 60-question science quiz and an interview, held in Poznan or abroad.

needs.note: The IB rule: at least one of these three at HL.
Grades in biology plus chemistry or maths/physics are required (at least two, including biology).

programmes.selectionNote: 60-question science quiz and a 20–40 minute interview; MCAT, UCAT, BMAT or GAMSAT scores, healthcare volunteering or research can earn bonus points.

programmes.name: Dentistry
programmes.about: Five-year, 300-ECTS dental degree straight from school: medical sciences first, then from year three treating patients in the PUMS Dental Clinic, with a dental simulation centre and summer clinical training each year.
programmes.ib: HL in Biology, Chemistry or Physics is required; admission is by a 60-question science quiz and an interview, and manual dexterity is expected.

needs.note: The IB rule: at least one of these three at HL.
Grades in biology plus chemistry or maths/physics are required (at least two, including biology).

programmes.selectionNote: Same science quiz and interview as Medicine; bonus points for admission tests or healthcare work. The programme runs only if at least 12 students are admitted.

notes: There is no EU rate: everyone pays the same tuition, which rises after year two (the MD totals 485,000 PLN over six years at 2026/27 prices).
Exam sessions also run in Bergen, Kristiansand, London and Dublin, plus one more Poznan session after the deadline; paying the 85 PLN processing fee unlocks practice quizzes in the applicant portal.
Two PUMS pages give different first days of classes for autumn 2027, so confirm the start with admissions before booking travel.
